name: Toxicologist
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Toxicologist and show them the *Cauldron*. Then have them choose two other players. Put the Toxicologist to sleep and then remove a potion from one of the chosen players if possible.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Toxicologist and show them the *Cauldron*. Then have them choose two other, alive players. Put the Toxicologist to sleep and then remove a potion from one of the chosen players if possible.
ability: Each night eye the cauldron, choose 2 living players (not yourself); a potion one of them holds break.
flavor: Exposure to toxins in our environment can have serious health consequences, so it’s important to take steps to minimize our exposure.
